title: Bochner–Riesz multipliers in three dimensions
main_claim: For every δ>0, T_δ (multiplier (1-|ξ|^2)_+^δ) is bounded on L^3(R^3); by interpolation and duality this gives the full strict Bochner–Riesz range δ > max{0, 3|1/p-1/2| - 1/2} in R^3. The proof reduces this to an L^3 oscillatory-integral estimate with λ^{-1+ν} loss for phases with straight packets (∂_vΦ = ζ(v, x-cv), with ∂_pζ definite). That estimate follows from an entropy 'packet growth' bound β_q ≤ γ/2, which in turn rests on a positive-transport growth bound β_c ≤ γ that uses Ren–Wang's Furstenberg estimate.

issues.location: Sections 4–8 (Theorem 4.2, positive-transport growth β_c ≤ γ) and Sections 9–11 (saturation arrays, boundary alternatives, prediction/alignment lemmas)
issues.description: Not an identified error; this is a coverage caveat. Everything rests on the classical growth theorem and on the multi-layer finite selection and retention machinery. In this pass I could only spot-check that machinery, not verify it line by line. For example, the forced alternative needs the normal-prediction accuracy ε^{4h}, which is only supported by the eccentricity condition a_j−b_j ≥ Mh/γ from Proposition 10.x; I did not trace that dependency end to end.
issues.evidence: Proposition boundary-alternatives (sec 10) supplies q cuts with a_j−b_j ≥ Mh/γ. The coherence step at sec 11, line ~1050, uses ∠(n(D),n(P)) ≤ Cε^{4h}, taken from the alignment lemma (lines 209–540), which I did not fully check.

coverage:
Section 12 checked in full:
- Lemma br-kernel: the exact slice formula π/(δ+1)∫(1−z²)^{1+δ}e^{2πiRz}dz and the endpoint decay R^{-2-δ}.
- Shell rescaling: λ^{1-δ}A_λ, with the shell norm λ^{-δ+ν}.
- Pseudoconformal change: |z−y| = s^{-1}g(Z−sv), Jacobian s^4, ∂_vΦ = ∓2π∇g(Dp−s_*v), Hessian sign and definiteness. The global convexification g̃ = g + h(|q|) has eigenvalues χ and h'/r in [0,1] and is ≥ 1/2 far out; the Gevrey (j!)^3 bounds hold.
- Slicing in y_3 and the cube-neighbor summation.
- Oscillatory-estimate proof: root score K_0 ≤ log|F| by log-sum plus the Bessel cap bound M_D ≲ ε^{a+b}; the endpoint mass absorption only needs differences of ζ, so no ∂_vζ bounds are required; Σm^{3/2} → ‖Ef‖_3 ≤ λ^{-1+γ/6+η/3}|F|^{1/3}; restricted-type to strong via the tails and Hölder over O(log λ) levels.
- Lemma br-complex-order: the beta identity and the Gamma-quotient bound.
- Corollary: Stein interpolation between L^3 and L^∞ with θ = 1−3/p and δ = c+θ, which matches the conjectured threshold 1−3/p; the 2 ≤ p ≤ 3 case and duality.

Section 9: definitions and the scaling sanity check. The endpoint score at t=Planck=1 matches λ^3‖Ef‖_3^3. With Φ = x·v − c|v|²/2 the class contains the paraboloid, so the result would also imply the L^p→L^p restriction conjecture in R^3. I found no contradiction with known counterexamples, because the class forces straight, parallel-in-v tubes, which rules out the Bourgain/GHI curved-tube constructions.

Section 10: Proposition finite-packet-composition, deficit bookkeeping (d_0 + E(d_1+d_2+d_3) cancellation).

Section 11: coherence Lemma 11.x (d=1 and d=2 Gram/Schur bounds and the ε^h atom–test entries); the entropy chain giving (coherent-entropy-repayment), whose B_1 cancellations I re-derived; the faithful-aperture classical bound; the credit-information inequality; the weight changes (1−γ)h and 2h; the final P_t ≤ B_r + γh + (k−k_f)/2, hence k ≥ k_f + (4β−2γ)h − 2Δ; the capacity k ≤ dh; and the q-step contradiction arithmetic.

Not verified: Sections 2–8 (entropy conditioning, the Ren–Wang projection form, the classical extremality, isotropic exclusion, characteristic-plane traces, rate transfer, classical closure), the selection/retention lemmas of sections 10–11, and the normal-prediction/alignment lemmas. Given the paper's length (~8800 lines) and the size of the claim (a major open problem), this verdict has low confidence.
sibling_notes: There were no sibling entries on the board for family 078 when I checked. The paper names companion OpenAI papers (spherical extension, diagonal extension, local smoothing) but says they are not inputs to this argument, and I found no circular dependence on them.
